round: tour r3 (v16.4): fixes for review-user.json and review-regress.json
work: work/xvtr (a copy of v16.2; merge base notes/v16.2-candidate)
summary: All 17 findings are fixed at the root; none rejected. The first run of this step made the fixes but was cut off before its last tests and this ledger. This run checked its work in the browser, kept all of it, and fixed what the restored audit found at 768-1023 px: a left drawer covered the strip (an r3 regression), and X's lit patch ran under that drawer (as in v16.2). What still fails is at 844 x 390 only: 8 of 7031 audit checks (4 per language). All of them are the same on the published v16.2 and come from the app's landscape layout: the tool row and the deformation's transport sit under the chain bar, and the shape list is below the Tools sheet's fold.

findings.title: Phone: the function chain never moves on; the sheet cannot be closed
findings.fix: A layer that holds one of the step's lit parts (the Editor sheet with the lens the chain's task opens) is part of the step and holds nothing (syncLayers). Once any task is done the shade and rings fade out and let every press through (r.quiet, .tour-quiet), so the sheet's x, X and Y work during the 3 s.
findings.evidence: tour_auto_cmd 'phone chain: the lens ticks it and nothing holds the countdown', 'the sheet's close button can be pressed', 'moves on 3 s after the lens' and 'done: the spotlight steps aside' pass. Shot: notes/tour-r3/review-fix-shots/p-chain-done-390.png (countdown running, held [], no shade).

findings.title: Phone: Sets from formulas asks for a task nothing notices
findings.fix: tryWide removed: the step asks its task on every screen (the step's tools sheet holds the field and Add on a phone). The example is now |z+1|<1, not the field's placeholder.
findings.evidence: t_tour 'basics/formula asks its task on every screen'; tour_auto_cmd 'phone formula: the task shows (a ring)' and 'Add ticks it and it moves on 3 s after' pass.

findings.title: Russian at 360 px: the Grieg captions are cut
findings.fix: The strip measures every line of the chapter (leads, tasks, results, hints, captions) at its width (needLines); a chapter that needs three lines gets a 76 px portrait row (56 px landscape row). In the portrait row the act button takes Back's place (Back is in Why), so the line keeps its width while a piece plays. The Russian captions were shortened too.
findings.evidence: tour_auto_cmd 'RU 360: the Sound chapter needs at most 3 lines, and the strip has them' and 'four captions and the result, none cut, the title in place' pass. Shots: notes/tour-r3/review-fix-shots/ru360-song-sound-off.png, ru360-caption-drum.png.

findings.title: The 3 s countdown on Next is almost invisible
findings.fix: The countdown is a 3 px bar (4 px on touch) along Next's bottom edge in Next's own label colour, so it has the label's contrast against the button (4.5:1 or more; the old fill was 1.26:1). Reduced motion keeps 'Next · 3, 2, 1'. Next also shows a ready ring once the task is done.
findings.evidence: tour_audit_cmd checks con.bar (the bar against Next's fill) >= 4.5:1 at every step, light and dark. Shots: notes/tour-r3/review-fix-shots/next-countdown-1440-light.png, next-countdown-1440-dark.png.

findings.title: A chapter's last task never moves on
findings.fix: Only Back (a step reached with Back), Move on by itself off, a press on the text, or no following step stop the countdown. A chapter's last task moves on 3 s after it is done into the next chapter, which Next names.
findings.evidence: tour_auto_cmd 'Patterns (a chapter's end): tick and result' and 'moves on 3 s after, into Editing the chain' pass.

findings.title: Sound settings shows the tour's borrowed sound; the user's choice is undone
findings.fix: A step of the Sound chapter with no sound of its own (Sound settings) gives everything back (holdSound -> soundHold(null)), so the menu shows the user's own settings. A setting the user changes while the tour holds it becomes theirs (app.js tourSndMine on the menu, Shift+M, the toast) and is not given back.
findings.evidence: tour_auto_cmd 'Sound settings: the sound given back there (off, as the user had it)', 'after the chapter: sound and Hear the function off again' and 'RU: Hear the function, set by the user during the chapter, stays theirs after it' pass.

findings.title: Phone portrait: no visible way to end the tour; the text does not show it opens
findings.fix: A 44 px x End stays in the portrait row; a chevron follows the step count (after the title in landscape); Next is a 44 px arrow named 'Next' (its full label as its name).
findings.evidence: tour_auto_cmd 'phone: x End in the portrait row (44 px), a chevron after the count, Next an arrow named "Next"'; tour_phone_cmd button sizes. Shot: notes/tour-r3/review-fix-shots/p-strip-390.png.

findings.title: Phone: 'Press Listen.' but the button shows only the icon
findings.fix: The listen task reads 'Press ▶ to listen.' (RU «Нажмите ▶, чтобы слушать.»), and with the sound off 'Press ▶ to turn sound on and listen.' (try.off), so the turn-on is said on every screen.
findings.evidence: t_tour 'sound/song: the task names ▶ and has a sound-off variant'. Shot: notes/tour-r3/review-fix-shots/ru360-song-sound-off.png («Нажмите ▶: обзор включит звук и сыграет.»).

findings.title: Phone Preimages: a short hold pans Y and nothing says why
findings.fix: The touch task reads 'Hold inside the disc until the ring fills, then slide out.' A pan of Y during the step (view-moved, pane R) replaces the task line with 'That moved Y: hold still until the ring fills, then slide.' until the task is done (try.hint).
findings.evidence: t_tour 'basics/preimages: the touch task names the ring and a hint answers a pan of Y'; tour_auto_cmd 'phone preimages: a short hold that pans Y shows the hint'.

findings.title: Landscape phone, Russian: Part of the chain task cut in the header strip
findings.fix: A landscape header strip whose chapter needs three lines takes the row under the header instead (r.forceRow), 48 px, or 56 px for three lines; the whole chapter keeps that place.
findings.evidence: tour_auto_cmd 'RU landscape: Part of the chain's task not cut (the row under the header)'; tour_phone_cmd 'the strip in one place through the chapter' at 844 x 390 and 780 x 360. Shot: notes/tour-r3/review-fix-shots/ru-land-range.png.

findings.title: Sets from formulas never moves on when added with Enter
findings.fix: A focused field holds the countdown only while it holds text not yet sent; checked on focus, input and every 250 ms (the app empties the field without an input event) and at done.
findings.evidence: tour_auto_cmd 'formula: added with Enter, the focus still in the emptied field: moves on 3 s after Enter'.

findings.title: At 1024 x 700 the strip and panes jump 204 px on Editing the chain > The Inspector
findings.fix: At a chapter's start the side panel one of its steps docks opens before the scene loads (showPanel early); a drawer or a phone's sheet still waits for its own step, so nothing covers the work area uninvited.
findings.evidence: Browser probe 1024 x 700, edit chapter, all six steps: strip [52, 744] and panes 692 x 382 at every step (notes/tour-r3/review-fix-shots/d1024-edit-inspector.png); tour_audit_cmd 'the strip in one place through the chapter (and the panes one size)' at 1024 x 700.

findings.title: The audit lost its spotlight-exact, layers, follow and focus passes and its sizes
findings.fix: test/tour_audit_cmd.js runs v16.2's spotlight-exact, lit-control, layers (with layerAll), follow and focus passes again through test/tour_audit_spot.js (v16.2's probe, ported: the strip is a window of the shade), at v16.2's sizes 360, 390, 844 x 390, 768, 1024 x 700, 1152 x 720 and 1440. The layers pass found that r3 had stopped masking the rings off the app's toasts: fixed in tour.js. This fix pass's run found two more r3 regressions and two v16.2 items, see 'extra'.

findings.title: On a small laptop the strip takes 17 % of the panes, 40 % with Why open; every toggle resizes the canvases
findings.fix: On a desktop whose panes would keep less than 360 px with Why inline (1366 x 657), Why opens only on a press, as a panel over the work area (the phone's panel), and folds at every step; the panes keep one size. Inline Why never shrinks during a tour, so the panes change size at most when a taller chapter comes.
findings.evidence: tour_auto_cmd '1366 x 657: Why opens as a panel over the work area, the panes keep their size'. Probe: panes 409 px without the tour, 339 with the strip, 339 with Why open. Shot: notes/tour-r3/review-fix-shots/d1366x657-why-panel.png.

findings.title: The live region says 'Next step in 3 seconds.' while held
findings.fix: Said at done only when the countdown runs; a held countdown announces it when the last hold ends (cdSync).
findings.evidence: tour_auto_cmd 'palette: while held the live region does not promise 3 seconds' and 'once it closes the live region says "Next step in 3 seconds."'.

findings.title: Doors move on with Move on by itself off
findings.fix: The reducer checks off before a door: with Move on by itself off a door only ticks.
findings.evidence: t_tour 'countdown: Move on by itself off -> a door only ticks'; tour_auto_cmd 'Move on by itself off: a door (Three views) ticks and stays 3 s'.

findings.title: After the tour on a phone the root keeps --ph-hp and --ph-ride
findings.fix: slot() shares out the phone geometry again only while a sheet is open; onTour(false) removes --ph-hp/--ph-ride when they were not set before the tour; stop() removes an empty style attribute the root did not have.
findings.evidence: tour_auto_cmd 'phone: no style left on the root after the tour'; probe at 390 x 844, 844 x 390 and 1440 x 900: the root's style attribute null before and after.

extra.title: At 768-1023 px a left drawer a step opens covered the strip's first 208 px
extra.detail: Your shapes, Sets from formulas and Patterns open the left drawer. The drawer sits over the stage from its top (absolute, z 20), and the strip is the stage's first row, so the drawer hid Back, the title and the start of the line. v16.2's callout sat beside the drawer.
extra.fix: desk.css (768-1023 px): .layout:not(.hide-left) > .panel.left { top: var(--tour-h, 0px) }. The drawer starts under the strip while the tour runs. Without the tour --tour-h is unset, so the top is 0 as before; golden images and perf baselines are untouched.
extra.evidence: Probe at 768 x 1024: the drawer was [8, 44, 260, 1016] over the strip [52, 44, 760, 106]; it is now [8, 114, 260, 1016]. The audit's 'strip meets none of the panes, the chain, the tool row' check passes at 768 (see tests). Shot: notes/tour-r3/review-fix-shots/t768-shapes-drawer-fixed.png.

extra.title: 768-1023 px, Your shapes: X's lit patch ran under the drawer and trimmed the lit Select tool
extra.detail: The 'also' patch of X (paneL) was lit as X's whole box, so the drawer's tool grid showed undimmed inside it. Trimming the two patches apart cut 13 px off the Select tool's patch (d = 13.27 px, the same on v16.2).
extra.fix: tour.js sideCut(): when an open layer from api.layers() covers one whole side of a lit part other than the anchor, that part is lit only up to the layer's edge, with square corners there. Desktop and tablet only; a phone's sheets keep the spotlight drawn inside them (hostPlan). The audit's probe applies the same cut to what it expects.
extra.evidence: Probe at 768 x 1024, basics/shapes: X's hole was [65, 114, 402, 492] and is now [260, 114, 402, 492]. The Select tool's hole is exact (d 13.27 -> 0.03). t_tour 1715/1715 and t_tour_engine 11/11 still pass.

extra.title: views/key failed 'control lit' (ctlNone) where the Phase key check is folded into Y's Display options
extra.detail: In Russian at 768 and 1024 px, Y's strip has no room for the check, so the step lights Y's Display options button instead. That is how the step was written in v16.2 (tour.js comment and INTEGRATION.md: 'Phase key lights Y's Display options button when Y's strip has no room for the check'). The audit table knew only the check.
extra.fix: CTL['views/key'] accepts '#rightFoot .opts-btn' when the check is not on screen.
extra.evidence: Probe: 1024 RU and 768 RU, Tour.lit().anchor = the options button [824, 441, 848, 465] / [616, 437, 640, 461]; #wKeyChkR is absent.

extra.title: The Select tool under a landscape phone's chain bar counted as the task's control
extra.detail: At 844 x 390, #tools > .tool[select] is laid out under the chain bar (elementsFromPoint at its centre gives the chain bar), and the tools live in a sheet. X: the domain, Branch cuts and Zeros and poles have already chosen Select.
extra.fix: The audit's tool() takes a desktop tool row button only when it is on top at its centre, the tour aside. On a phone, a Select tool that cannot be reached is no control ('none').
extra.evidence: Probe on v16.2 and r3 (same result): select [564, 342, 617, 388] under .pipe-wrap / the shade.

extra.title: The exceptions check failed on the engine's 'step skipped' warnings; the tool-row overlap ignored clipping
extra.detail: v16.2's audit left '[tour] step skipped' out of the exceptions check. A skipped step has its own row there, and the r3 audit counts it in 'every step visited'. views/key is skipped at 844 x 390 since v15. Separately, the strip-against-tool-row check used #secDraw's full box, including the part a scrolled drawer clips.
extra.fix: The exceptions check leaves out 'step skipped' warnings and lists them in 'skipped'. The tool row's box is cut by its clipping ancestors.
